messages:
zoe_marketing: Quick ask for launch/blog + webinar: can runtime run a compact bench sanity pack we can cite?

zoe_marketing: Needs: ~400 anonymized samples stratified by token length (short/med/long), fp16 + int8 runs, coldstart vs warmed (3 warmups), gen p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, est cost / 1M tokens, and embed p95 for med slice. Deliver CSV + one demo trace + short bullet summary.

zoe_marketing: CSV columns please: variant, slice, run_type, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tps, est_cost_per_1M_tokens. ETA by EOD Thu?

omar_runtime: Can do. Quick clarifiers: which model names to cite and staging vs prod runs?

zoe_marketing: Cite redwood-v1-base (gen) and redwood-embed-english-v1 (embed). Staging is fine but note GPU type. Use anonymized sampled payloads.

jen_eng-runtime: We'll run on staging (A10g). Plan: 3 repeats per variant, coldstart = pod restart, warm = 3 warmups per worker. We'll include runner config and seed list in the bundle.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: bench-mini-1991234567 queued on staging at 2025-07-14T10:00:00Z. Job id: bench-mini-1991234567.

omar_runtime: Coldstart sweep done: prelim gen p95(fp16) = 300ms(short), 520ms(med), 1280ms(long). int8 ~13% lower on med. No OOMs.

maya_product: For the webinar slide we want a single callout: exact % reduction for 256-token med slice. Can you include that micro-run?

omar_runtime: Micro-run (256-token med slice) med of 3: fp16 p95 = 512ms, int8 p95 = 445ms -> ~13.1% reduction. tokens/sec fp16=225, int8=265. est cost/1M tokens fp16=$12.00, int8=$10.50 (staging rates).

omar_runtime: Uploaded bundle: s3://redwood-staging/bench-mini-1991234567/bundle.zip. CSV + runner-config + warmup-seedlist + demo trace included.

omar_runtime: One-liner for blog: "Measured on staging (A10g) with anonymized stratified inputs; values are medians over 3 runs. See attached traces for full reproducibility."

zoe_marketing: Perfect 1 thanks! We'll draft the copy and tag you for final sign-off. Please keep the runner config visible so we can repro the demo on demand. :rocket:
